query: A Letter That Wasn't Posted The envelope is on your pillow, though the door was locked and the window shut. Inside, a single line: the Crown's Office of Unseen Affairs has a desk for you, if you want it, from the autumn. There is no address to reply to. They'll know your answer on the last day. Leave a "yes" on the pillow You leave one word on the pillow and go to supper. When you come back, the paper is gone and the bed has been made. You did not make it. Find out how they got in You spend a week on it and find the scratch on the window catch, the loose tile, the borrowed key. It's very good work. That's the trouble.
